newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re sees fall in 96/97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re sees fall in 96/97 EPS.

text.p: German reinsurer Munich Re said on Monday it expected its earnings per share to fall in the current 1996/97 business year and said overall earnings could also fall below its 1995/96 net profit.
In 1995/96, group earnings per share jumped to 140 marks ($93.04) from 67.60 marks and group net profit rose 83.1 percent to 595 million marks.

Chief Executive Hans-Juergen Schinzler said he expected the purchases of health insurer Deutsche Krankenversicherung (DKV) and American Re to bear fruit in the 1997/1998 year and that earnings were merely "taking a breather" in 1996/97.
Munich Re's business year runs to June 30.
